entries.def:
ἐμ-πορεύομαι depon. 
(ἔμπορος), [in LXX chiefly for סָחַר ;] 
__1. to travel, esp. for business. 
__2. to traffc, trade: Jas.4.13. 
__3. C. accusative of thing(s) 
__(a) to traffic in; 
__(b) to import: (Hos.12.1, for יָבַל hoph.). 
__4. C. accusative of person(s), to make a gain of: 2Pe.2.3.†
(AS)

ἐμπορία, -ας, ἡ
(ἔμπορος), [in LXX for סָחַר, רָכַל etc. ;] 
commerce, business, trade: Mat.22.5.†
(AS)

ἐμπόριον, -ον, τό
(ἔμπορος) [in LXX: Deu.33.19 (סָפַן), Ezk.27.3 (רָכַל); ἐ. εἶναι, Isa.23.17 (זָנָה)* ;] 
a trading place, exchange: οἶκος ἐμπορίου, Jhn.2.16.†
(AS)

ἔμ-πορος, -ου, ὁ
(πόρος, a journey), [in LXX chiefly for סָחַר, רָכַל ;] 
__1. a passenger on shipboard, one on a journey. 
__2. a merchant: Mat.13.45, Rev.18.3, 11; 18.15, 23.†
(AS)

ἐμ-πίπρημι, 
ἐμπρήθω (for the form, see: ἐμπίπλημι, and cf. Veitch, see word πίμπρημι), [in LXX chiefly for שָׂרַף ;] 
to set on fire: πόλιν, Mat.22.7 pass., of the body, to become inflamed: Act.28.6 (T; πίμπρημι WH, which see).†
(AS)

ἔμ-προσθεν 
adv. 
of place (in cl. also of time), 
[in LXX chiefly for עֳנִי ;] 
__1. adverbially, before, in front: Luk.19.28 εἰς τὸ ἔ., Luk.19.4 opposite to ὄπισθεν, Rev.4.6 opposite to τὰ ὀπίσω, τὰ ἔ., Php.3.13. 
__2. As prep., before; 
__(a) in front of: Mat.5.24; 6.2; 7.6; 11.10; 27.29, Luk.5.19; 7.27; 14.2, Jhn.3.28; 10.4, Rev.19.10; 22.8; 
__(b) in the presence of: Mat.27.11, Gal.2.14, 1Th.1.3; 2.19; 3.9;…

ἐμ-πτύω 
[in LXX: before εἰς, Num.12.14 A, Deu.25.9 (יָרָק)* ;] 
= cl., καταπτύω (Ruth., NPhr., 66), 
to spit upon: with dative, Mrk.10.34; 14.65; 15.19; before εἰς, Mat.26.67; 27.30. Pass., Luk.18.32.†
(AS)

ἐμφανής, -ές
(ἐμφαίνω, to show in, exhibit), [in LXX: Mic.4.1, Isa.2.2 (כּוּן ni.), Wis.6.22; 7.21; 14.17; ἐ. γίνεσθαι, Exo.2.14 (יָדַע ni.), Isa.65.1 (דָּרַשׁ ni.)* ;] 
manifest: Act.10.40 metaphorically, Rom.10.20 (LXX) (see: ἐπιφανής).†
(AS)

ἐμφανίζω 
[in LXX for יָדַע hi., etc. ;] 
__1. to manifest, exhibit: ἐαυτόν, with dative of person(s), Jhn.14.21-22 (DCG, ii, 112b). Pass. and mid., to show oneself, appear: Mat.27.53, Heb.9.24 (cf. MM, Exp., xii). 
__2. to declare, make known: before ὅτι, Heb.11.14 with dative of person(s), Act.23.15 with accusative of thing(s), before πρός, Act.23.22 κατά, with genitive of person(s), Act.24.1; 25.2; περί,…

ἔμ-φοβος 
[in LXX: Sir.19.24, 1Ma.13.2 * ;] 
__1. terrible. 
__2. in fear (of Godly fear, Sir.19.24), terrified: Luk.24.5, 37, Act.10.4; 24.25, Rev.11.13.†
(AS)
